TouchBistro gets no copy of the order: Nothing you send from our app turns into a PO in TouchBistro's Inventory Management. If you track those items there, record the delivery there yourself, as you would for any order made outside it.

Partner inventory apps stay linked: A partner inventory app linked to TouchBistro keeps its link. Count in it as you do now. Where a distributor uses our app, read out the items you need and check the lines.

Leave online vendors where they are: If a vendor already takes your orders online through TouchBistro, leave that vendor there. Our app is for a distributor you still reach by phone or through the rep.

@graph.name: Do I need a TouchBistro alternative to speak a supply order?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. All it takes is a distributor with our app. Then you talk that order into the app, so there is no call to make.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than TouchBistro?

acceptedAnswer.text: The two are built for separate jobs. Payments, tables, tableside orders, guest online orders, staff and stock counts: we do none of these, and we are not a POS. Ours is the order to a distributor on our app, spoken aloud and checked one item at a time. In TouchBistro's add-ons, you put each order together on screen; if you prefer to say it, that takes no TouchBistro alternative.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and TouchBistro connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They are separate companies, each with its own help desk, and they share no data. Whatever you say in our app is sent to your distributor alone; neither TouchBistro nor a tool linked to it gets a copy.

@graph.name: If my reason for leaving is the POS itself, will this help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not with that part. Payments, tables or menu screens need a different POS, and we do not make one. If you move to another POS later, ordering in our app carries on as before, because it was never connected to TouchBistro.

@graph.name: I already order through TouchBistro Inventory Management. How does this fit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stay with it for the vendors you order from online or by email. Where a distributor has our app, you can speak that order instead. Send each distributor's order from one place only, so nothing is ordered twice.

@graph.name: What happens if I say "six" and the screen shows sixteen?

acceptedAnswer.text: You catch it on the review screen before sending: change the amount, swap the item, or delete the line. That review is the safeguard, so a hurried glance can still let a mistake through. A phoned-in or voicemail order gets no number from us; only orders placed in the app carry one.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through your distributor: they open your account, and most kitchens place a first order the same day. If yours does not have it, order from them as you do today, and get in touch: we will work out who you should talk to. For cost, ask the distributor you would get the app from; we publish no price. TouchBistro lists prices for its POS plans and gives quotes for its back-office tools.

@graph.name: Where do the TouchBistro details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: From touchbistro.com as we read it on 9 November 2026: its POS page, the pages for both back-office add-ons, plus pricing and integrations. On that date we saw nothing there about ordering supplies by speaking. Inventory Management is offered in the continental US and in Canada outside Quebec. We left out TouchBistro's own customer counts and savings claims. If any of it has gone out of date, send us a note and we will put it right.
